title: One catalog, fewer conflicting model lists
summary:
The model catalog became the shared source of truth while new models, clearer API behavior, and better places to build took shape around it.

Enter, the public site, activity views, key permissions, and Model Monitor now draw model details from the live catalog. Model-list API responses include category and display metadata, and an SDK alpha preserves unfamiliar categories rather than dropping them. Enter also restored one-click copying of model API IDs.

Pruna gained separate `p-video-720p` and `p-video-1080p` models; its existing video aliases select 720p, so 1080p requires the explicit model. Wan gained a separate `wan-pro-1080p` option and end-frame guidance, alongside a repair to Wan Pro image-to-video requests. The API docs caught up with the resolution choices.

Paid-only `claude-fable-5` was added with text and image input, tools, and a 1M-token context. Coding-focused `kimi-k2.7-code` was added with reasoning, tools, image input, and a 262,144-token context window.

Image and video content-policy rejections now return HTTP 422 with a stable `content_policy_violation` code instead of looking like server failures. Inert options were removed from schemas and client tools, while older image requests that send those keys are ignored. MCP audio tools now accept voices returned by `listAudioVoices`.
